name: notification-open-last-line
description: All three NotificationCard summary shapes (secondary with an Open control, secondary alone, title-only) keep their trailing chevron - and the Open control where one exists - adjacent to the final text line at a narrow desktop content width and at phone width, never strand any of them on a line by themselves (each rides an atomic .secondaryTail unit with the words it opens), and center every trailing slot on that line: the flex-end cross alignment pins their 1lh wrappers to the line's end, and the glyph inside must not ride half-leading below the words.

mutation.declaration: notificationcard.module.css: remove the height:1lh (and align-items:center) from .openTrailing/.secondaryTail .chevron
mutation.note: Each wrapper rule was reverted separately and re-run on 2026-09-11: removing .openTrailing's height/align-items parks the Open glyph 3.7px low (both viewports, secondary-with-open), removing .secondaryTail .chevron's height parks the chevron 2.7px low (all three shapes, both viewports), and reverting .secondaryTail to display:inline strands the trailing slots below the final text line - now proven on the no-ref shapes too (a bare inline chevron stranded at 8 of 56 swept widths pre-fix, roborev #1143). The bare 1em Open slot (and 14px chevron box) seat flush against the line box's bottom edge under flex-end and poke below the line.
